properties.description:
Delivery One is the first choice of so many areas of business because Delivery One couriers are professionally dressed and courteous at all times. Delivery One was established to represent that business in the most professional and intellectual methods and attitude.

Delivery One also cooperates with different corporate to ensure their services are enhanced to meet the expectation plus satisfaction of VIP’s clients, such corporate are travel agencies and Non –profit organizations.

On Time Delivery: We at Delivery One understand that our most important mission is your delivery that’s why we have installed a state of art dispatch and tracking system that allows Delivery One to constantly monitor deliveries. If a traffic problem arises Delivery One can route couriers via a communication system that assures you of the most reliable service available.

Delivery One Fleet: It may not have been obvious to you but Delivery One fleet of well maintained vehicles makes Delivery One more dependable than other companies who use only subcontractors vehicles. Plus, you’re guaranteed that Delivery One company owned vehicles are fully insured and prepared to serve their purposes.

Delivery One has 102 vehicles that include 2 big catering (cooling) vehicles.
